newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Oct 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Oct 27.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Labour and social affairs minister warns private sector firms against missing deadline to increase the number of nationals on their staff by five percent.
- Industry and electricity minister says ministry has plans to implement new electricity projects worth 26 billion riyals.
- The first phase of a 200 million riyal expansion programme at the Industrial Gases Company is completed.
- Saudi's yearly income from production of water boilers stands at 108 million riyals, study says.
- Saudi commerce minister says exports to America reach 31 billion riyals in 1995.
